entry.title: Steins;Gate
entry.overview: An eccentric scientist invents a microwave that can send messages into the past.
entry.notes: El Psy Kongroo. The greatest sci-fi anime ever made.

entry.title: Hunter x Hunter (2011)
entry.overview: Gon Freecss aspires to become a Hunter to find his father.
entry.notes: Chimera Ant arc is unmatched in emotional and thematic depth.

entry.title: Suzume
entry.overview: A modern action adventure road story where a 17-year-old girl named Suzume helps close doors causing disasters.
entry.notes: Makoto Shinkai disaster trilogy culmination. Wonderful chair companion.

entry.title: Cyberpunk: Edgerunners
entry.overview: A street kid trying to survive in Night City, a technology and body modification-obsessed city of the future.
entry.notes: Studio Trigger animation and 'I Really Want to Stay At Your House'.

entry.title: Frieren: Beyond Journey's End
entry.overview: An elven mage and her fellow adventurers have defeated the Demon King and brought peace to the land.
entry.notes: A breathtaking meditation on time, memory, and mortal connection.

entry.title: Vinland Saga
entry.overview: Raised by Vikings who murdered his family, Thorfinn becomes a terrifying warrior.
entry.notes: I have no enemies. Season 2 farm arc transformed this into a philosophical classic.
